kinds.label: Periodic poll
kinds.note: A body run again and again while conditions hold; delay per outcome; needs a long-running host (Android foreground service)

kinds.label: One-off
kinds.note: Run once, retried by the outcome rules; survives process death through the platform scheduler

kinds.label: Alarm
kinds.note: Run at a wall-clock time (exact only when the platform allows)

kinds.label: Constrained periodic
kinds.note: Platform-scheduled periodic work with constraints (network, charging…); 15 min minimum on Android (WorkManager)

kinds.label: Chain
kinds.note: Jobs that run after each other

errors: job spec must be an object
job kind alarm is a placeholder (not built yet)
outcome ok: fixed delay needs ms ≥ 1
outcome ok: exponential delay needs maxMs ≥ baseMs
outcome ok: exponential factor must be ≥ 1
outcome ok: notice must be a non-empty string
every condition needs a flag name
condition charging: unknown kind "battery" (it would never hold)
